completion_criteria.text: U1-U7 experiments run and recorded in a companion findings doc; each claim marked verified or refuted with evidence, before any step that depends on it
Step 0 shipped: protect-claude-config.sh narrowed to the gate implementation and deny list only, ask converted to deny, confirmed live
Steps 1-2 shipped: deny pruned to D1-D5 only; all ask rules retired and hook ask branches converted to checkpoint-and-allow or block
Steps 3-4 shipped: broad Bash allow plus mcp__* coverage; settings.local.json truncated to reusable prefix rules and accumulation stopped at source
Layer 1 shipped whole: temp-index checkpoint, rm-to-trash rewrite, hourly APFS snapshot, and the D2 age-based reaper in the same change
Layer 3 shipped: one PreToolUse gate, P0-P6 in order, allow/block only, fail-open except P1/P2/P5, honoring the D3 local-container carve-out
Layer 4 shipped: append-only tool-call audit log plus a SessionStart heartbeat asserting layers 0 and 1 and the promotion pointer
Layer 0 shipped: sandbox enabled with failIfUnavailable, gated on the U3 result
Steps 8-9 shipped: inert and harmful hooks deleted; logbook plugin fail-closed guard disabled or patched (R6)
R3 rule change landed: the standing --dangerously-skip-permissions prohibition replaced by a rule requiring layers 0, 1 and 4 live first
One PR per MSP opened through the centralized pr-create tool, each leaving its base branch green

spine.active_goal: Implement the ratified maximum-autonomy permission architecture end to end: experiments first, then the ordered change set, one PR per MSP.
spine.next_step: Wave 0 is running: four parallel agents covering U1/U2/U6 (permission-mode semantics), U3/U4/U5 plus the temp-index checkpoint re-measurement, the promotion pipeline and U7, and the hook/deny-list current-state map. On their return, resolve the Step 0 narrowing-target question, then decompose into MSPs and ship through mitosis. No implementation may start before the experiment each step depends on has run.
spine.last_session: Read the SPEC, opened this child build thread, established config ground truth, and dispatched Wave 0 measurement agents. Nothing implemented.

open_risks.text: Step 0's narrowing target is ambiguous — clamping repo paths to the gate implementation would deny building the gate itself, so the guard must almost certainly clamp the live copy under ~/.claude rather than version-controlled source
Live is pinned at release 482dc7d while repo HEAD is 31bdd62 — three commits never promoted, so a config change may silently no-op until the promotion pipeline is understood
converge.mjs runs on Stop — any committed hook change can auto-promote at the end of a turn, putting a half-built gate live mid-build
The promotion source is unestablished for git worktrees — mitosis fan-out shares one git dir, so a worktree HEAD could become the promoted release
settings.local.json holds 202 allow rules and grew during the SPEC-authoring session — the accumulation source must be stopped, not just the file truncated

key_decisions.title: D2 guards the live installed copy, not version-controlled source
